existing_application.stack: React client, existing catalog API; no new infrastructure requested

feature_requests.need: A short readable explanation of an item, grounded in available catalog evidence; visitors may ask follow-up questions.
Import the source object identity, title, maker when known, and provenance/source references; incomplete source facts must remain distinguishable from source disagreements.

existing_application.accepted_authority: An editor must accept proposed catalog changes; this design request grants no write authority.

sources.text: The acquisition card lists an unsigned work, estimated 1880–1890.
A later inventory tentatively attributes the work to R. Vale; the attribution is unconfirmed.
